Background / History
Porcelain found herself suddenly... existing. Frightened by callous stares and whispers, she sought immediate solitude. As she evaded public scrutiny over the following years, she slowly and steadily gained power. Or perhaps she simply better learned to harness what she already had. She eventually made her way to Puerto Rico, where she was living when hurricane Maria devasted the area in 2017. Unable to sit idly on her abilities, she finally abandonded her anonymity to lend aid. Subsequently seen performing dangerous rescues and miraculous healings, she was affectionately dubbed "The Saint of San Juan" and "The White Angel" by the locals. As she now realizes an even greater increase in her strength, she has come to understand that it can be best put to use somewhere... bigger. Welcome to New York.

Porcelain is actually a clay golem, forged by an evil wizard who sought to make a personal protector. Vastly underestimating the amount of arcane energy he would encounter when the Gates of Dawn opened, he was nearly killed mid-ritual. Porcelain was molded, animated, and then imbued with great power in an arcane explosion that left the wizard incapacitated and the final binding spell incomplete. After regaining consciousness, he was unaware that his initial incanations had even succeeded until he saw news footage from San Juan. Now realizing what immense power she must have absorbed, he seeks to complete his bindings and control her completely.
